wetsuit_logic._overlap_note: The two 3/2s overlap at 18-20C. Winter defaults to the warmer suit (first in the list); outside winter the lighter one leads with the warmer offered as the windy/overcast alternate.
wetsuit_logic._fallback_note: Out of range: below the coldest lo use the FIRST suit, above the warmest hi use the LAST. Never index 0 blindly.
